title: Features of Plants and Animals
seo_title: Foundation Science: Features of Plants and Animals Worksheets (Australian Curriculum)
standard_text: Observe external features of plants and animals and describe ways they can be grouped based on these features (Australian Curriculum v9.0 Science content description).
meta_desc: Free Foundation science worksheets on the features of plants and animals: body parts, fur, feathers and scales, legs, wings and fins, and the parts of a plant. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Look closely at plants and animals.
key_sub: Animals have body parts like legs, wings and fur. Plants have roots, stems and leaves.
body_html:
How to think about it

Living things have parts we can see.

  • Animals: legs, wings, fins, fur, feathers or scales.
  • Plants: roots, stem, leaves and flowers.
  • Use your eyes and hands to observe.
Example

What covers a kookaburra?

it is a bird

Answer: feathers

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up fur and feathers.
  • Thinking all animals have legs (snakes and fish do not).

faq.a: They are the parts you can see on the outside, such as legs, wings, fur, leaves and flowers.

faq.a: Animals like the kangaroo, koala, platypus and echidna live naturally only in Australia.
